data.title: 不知火舞 · 练习扇上的新流苏
data.description: 练习后的道场里，舞穿靛蓝作务衣跪坐在坐垫上，把新的红流苏系到折扇柄上。她拉紧小结，展开扇面检查是否碰到扇骨，随后轻轻抖腕试出顺畅的一弧，高马尾随动作摆动。
data.action: 系紧扇柄新流苏，展开扇面轻抖手腕检查。
data.promptProse: Mai Shiranui kneels on the dojo cushion in securely tied indigo samue and white tabi, fastening the new red tassel to her sensu’s bamboo handle. She tightens the knot, opens the paper fan to check the ribs and tests a smooth wrist arc. The medium seated portrait includes the pleats across her knees. Floorboards run past the cushion toward the dojo’s plain practice wall and the lower edge of a side window. Morning light grazes the paper texture and red thread; small fan-rib shadows stay local to the fan, and the cushion presses a broader, softer shadow onto the boards beneath her folded legs.
